simple.meaning: דָּרַשׁ (dârash) appears 165 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering. The surrounding account also brings the name into conflict and blood crying from the ground.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Judges, and 10 more, beginning at Genesis 9:5. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, offering, blood, Torah, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דָּרַשׁ (H1875) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows דָּרַשׁ through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: דָּרַשׁ (dârash) / H1875 is tracked through Genesis 9:5, Genesis 25:22, Genesis 42:22, Exodus 18:15. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
